extDescription.message: Watch your AI agent sessions with a perch of bird icons. Pop any panel into a floating mini window. Zero permissions, no server.

setupIntro.message: Pick the session-log folder of the AI coding agent you use, and birds will start landing on the perch.

setupMovedFolderHint.message: If you moved an agent's folder with an environment variable (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, COPILOT_HOME, etc.), pick the folder with the same name inside it.

duplicateRootMessage.message: That folder is already on the perch

emptyNoSessions.message: No birds on the perch right now

emptyNeedsReauth.message: Needs re-authorization — reconnect from Watched Folders below

emptyNoEvents.message: No activity in the last 30 min

summonButton.message: Pop out to a mini window (always on top)

pipNote.message: The birds are out in the mini window.

byokTestNeedsKey.message: Save a key to test the connection.

byokTestFailedAuth.message: The key was rejected. Check that it's correct and still valid.

byokTestFailedRateLimit.message: Too many requests, or no credit left. Wait a moment, or check your plan and balance.

byokTestFailedServer.message: The service had a problem. Try again in a while.

byokTestFailedNetwork.message: Can't reach the service. Check your internet connection.

byokTestFailedMalformed.message: Couldn't read the service's answer. Try again in a while.

byokNoKeyMessage.message: Enter and save an API key first

byokUseForSummaryLabel.message: Use for summaries and the concierge

aiApiKeysDescription.message: Optional. Used for speech bubble summaries, the concierge, and voice summaries of done events. If more than one is set up, choose which one to use.

windowModeFloating.message: Floating (always on top, even over full-screen apps)

windowModeNormal.message: Standard window (can be maximized or go full screen)

askingBadgeTitle.message: Waiting for your answer before it can continue

angerBadgeTitle.message: A message you sent in this session’s last turn was judged abusive toward the AI

byokSaveFailedMessage.message: Couldn't save the key. Please try again.

hideWindowButtonLabel.message: Hide window (bring it back from the menu bar icon)

byokStoreUnavailable.message: API keys can't be saved because no keyring (GNOME Keyring or KWallet) is running on this computer. Start one, then reopen tomarigi.

voiceUnavailable.message: Reading aloud isn't available because this system has no speech engine.

conciergeTitle.message: Looks at all your sessions and suggests what to do next. Click to open that session

conciergeSettingsNote.message: Looks at all your sessions and tells you which one to handle next. Click it to jump to that session's pane. Appears while an OpenAI or Anthropic key is saved or Local is set up. Choose its look

updatesCheckFailed.message: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again

updatesRestartNote.message: tomarigi restarts to finish the update

updatesInstallFailed.message: The update didn't finish. tomarigi is still on the current version; try again

localAiDescription.message: Uses a model on an OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or LM Studio. No key needed.

localAiModelsFailed.message: Couldn't get the model list from this server. Type the model name.

localAiUrlInvalid.message: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://, without ?, #, or a user name and password.

localAiTestUnreachable.message: Can't reach the server. Check that it's running and the URL is right.

localAiNeedsModel.message: Choose or type a model to save and test the connection.

aiUserMessagesNote.message: Each time a turn finishes, the agent’s last reply and the messages you sent during that turn are sent. They also decide the “?” on birds waiting for your reply and the anger mark for abuse toward the AI.

retiredKeyNote.message: No longer used. You can delete this saved key.
